findings.evidenceJa: 校舎はとたんに静かになった
findings.governingReading: the school building suddenly became quiet
findings.explanation: A sudden completed transition to silence becomes gradual diminishing noise.

findings.evidenceJa: 蜘蛛の子を散らすが如し
findings.governingReading: like scattering spiderlings
findings.explanation: The vivid comparison for the students dispersing is omitted.

findings.highlight: Even if Sakura is going to stay over
findings.evidenceJa: 桜を泊まらせるにしても
findings.governingReading: even if I decide to have Sakura stay
findings.explanation: The proposed stay is phrased as already going to happen before Shirou has asked her.

findings.highlight: wait for her to come after her club activities
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が部活から帰ってきた後、折を見て切り出すべき
findings.governingReading: after Sakura returns from club, I should choose the right moment to broach it
findings.explanation: Waiting replaces the actual plan to raise the subject at an opportune moment.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜と藤ねえを説得する
findings.governingReading: convincing Sakura and Fuji-nee
findings.explanation: Sakura herself is omitted from the people Shirou knows he must persuade.

findings.highlight: I can’t be distracted by money during the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 生活費まで気にしだしたら聖杯戦争なんて出来たもんじゃない
findings.governingReading: if I start worrying even about living expenses, conducting the Holy Grail War will be impossible
findings.explanation: A practical incompatibility is softened into mental distraction.

findings.highlight: I should be repaying Sakura every chance I get
findings.evidenceJa: こうゆうところで桜にお返ししなければ
findings.governingReading: I should repay Sakura at times like this
findings.explanation: A specific opportunity for reciprocity becomes a continuous obligation.

findings.evidenceJa: ビニールいっぱいの食材
findings.governingReading: a plastic bag full of ingredients
findings.explanation: The singular shopping bag and ingredients for cooking become multiple bags of generic food.

findings.evidenceJa: 上等な鱈
findings.governingReading: fine-quality cod
findings.explanation: Quality is replaced by unsupported freshness.

findings.evidenceJa: 鍋物
findings.governingReading: a hot-pot dish
findings.explanation: The planned communal Japanese dish is changed to stew.

findings.evidenceJa: 意気揚揚と帰還しかけた足が止まる
findings.governingReading: my feet, just beginning their triumphant return, stop
findings.explanation: The interrupted triumphant movement and comic momentum disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 咄嗟に身構える俺
findings.governingReading: I instantly take a defensive stance
findings.explanation: A concrete combat-ready response becomes vague readiness to act.

findings.evidenceJa: 本当に嬉しそうな笑顔
findings.governingReading: a smile that looked genuinely delighted
findings.explanation: Illya’s apparent genuine joy at Shirou’s survival is reduced to smile size.

findings.evidenceJa: 一刀のもとに斬り伏せた
findings.governingReading: cut me down with a single stroke
findings.explanation: The precise overwhelming action is generalized to its near-fatal result.

findings.evidenceJa: ひょっこり現れた
findings.governingReading: popped up unexpectedly
findings.explanation: The incongruous casual suddenness of Illya appearing downtown is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤスそう、イリヤスフィール
findings.governingReading: Illyas—right, Illyasviel
findings.explanation: Shirou’s correction from the nickname to the first segment of her full name is lost.

findings.evidenceJa: 反射的に頭を下げる
findings.governingReading: I reflexively bow my head
findings.explanation: The involuntary physical apology is replaced with a generic speech act.

findings.evidenceJa: 今にも泣きそうな顔
findings.governingReading: a face that looks ready to cry at any moment
findings.explanation: Imminent tears are generalized to sadness.

findings.highlight: She’s glaring at me, probably because I shortened her name
findings.governingReading: Illya is silent; Shirou does not know why she looks ready to cry
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally invents both a glare and a causal explanation for it.

findings.highlight: I didn’t mean to make you mad
findings.evidenceJa: 悪気はなかった
findings.governingReading: I meant no harm
findings.explanation: Shirou denies malicious intent; the English asserts the specific effect he supposedly did not intend.

findings.highlight: No. Emiya is my last name
findings.evidenceJa: 今の発音だと『笑み社』じゃないか
findings.governingReading: with that pronunciation it becomes “smile shrine,” Emiya-shiro
findings.explanation: The missegmentation pun explaining Illya’s pronunciation error is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 発音があまりにもキテレツだった為、ついつっこみを入れてしまった
findings.governingReading: because her pronunciation was so bizarre, I reflexively retorted
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic astonishment and involuntary retort are neutralized.

findings.evidenceJa: 目を白黒させる
findings.governingReading: her eyes dart in bewilderment
findings.explanation: The idiomatic physical display of bewilderment is generalized.

findings.highlight: Even though I regret it, it’s too late
findings.evidenceJa: しまった、と思ったところで遅い
findings.governingReading: by the time I realize I have made a mistake, it is too late
findings.explanation: Immediate recognition of a blunder is changed into emotional regret.

findings.evidenceJa: シロウ、シロウ、かあうん
findings.governingReading: Shirou, Shirou… hmm
findings.explanation: Illya’s audible testing and consideration of the name’s sound are reduced.

findings.evidenceJa: 問答無用で、俺の腕に抱きついてきた
findings.governingReading: without allowing any argument, she clings to my arm
findings.explanation: The unilateral abruptness of Illya’s contact disappears.

findings.highlight: The neighbors might spread bad rumors
findings.evidenceJa: ご近所のおばさまたちから良からぬ噂
findings.governingReading: the neighborhood women may start improper rumors
findings.explanation: The particular social observers and suggestive quality of the rumors are generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 恐る恐る口にする
findings.governingReading: inactive commented narration
findings.explanation: mirror moon’s classic branch restores a semicolon-commented delivery line absent from the active script.

findings.highlight: Her gaze sends a chill down my spine
findings.evidenceJa: 背筋が総毛だった
findings.governingReading: the hair all along my spine stood on end
findings.explanation: The strong involuntary bodily reaction is reduced to a conventional chill.

findings.highlight: she can also become a ruthless Master
findings.evidenceJa: 冷酷なマスターの貌になる
findings.governingReading: her expression abruptly becomes the face of a ruthless Master
findings.explanation: The immediate visible transformation in Illya’s face becomes a generic capacity or identity.

findings.highlight: nor do I mind going ahead with my plans
findings.evidenceJa: 予定がちょっと早まるだけ
findings.governingReading: it only brings my schedule forward a little
findings.explanation: Illya’s threat that Shirou and Saber will simply die earlier than planned becomes awkward acquiescence to proceeding.

findings.highlight: Do you want to die along with Saber?
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーといっしょにここで死ぬ？
findings.governingReading: do you want to die here with Saber?
findings.explanation: The public location sharpening Illya’s threat is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 明るいうちは戦っちゃダメ
findings.governingReading: Masters must not fight while it is light
findings.explanation: A rule or prohibition becomes physical or categorical inability.

findings.evidenceJa: ふふん、と得意げにイリヤは笑う
findings.governingReading: inactive commented narration: Illya laughs proudly
findings.explanation: mirror moon’s classic branch activates a semicolon-commented reaction absent from the active scene.

findings.highlight: what she means by “all this time”
findings.evidenceJa: 何が“それぐらい”なのかわからない
findings.governingReading: I do not know what she means by “at least that much”
findings.explanation: Shirou’s confusion is attached to the wrong preceding phrase.

findings.highlight: she wouldn’t hesitate to make herself heard
findings.evidenceJa: 全力でイリヤの申し出を拒否する
findings.governingReading: she would reject Illya’s proposal with all her strength
findings.explanation: Saber’s hypothetical decisive refusal is replaced with merely voicing herself.

findings.evidenceJa: 無謀で無策で無考
findings.governingReading: reckless, planless, and thoughtless
findings.explanation: The three distinct failings lose the absence of any plan and duplicate recklessness instead.

findings.highlight: I wanted to talk with you
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤとは会って話がしたかった
findings.governingReading: I wanted to meet Illya and talk with her
findings.explanation: Shirou’s reciprocal wish to see Illya, not merely converse, is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 舞うように走り出す
findings.governingReading: Illya takes off running as though dancing
findings.explanation: The light visual character of Illya’s movement disappears.

findings.highlight: She twirls about as she runs
findings.evidenceJa: くるくるとはしゃぎながら走っていく
findings.governingReading: inactive commented narration
findings.explanation: mirror moon’s non-Realta branch restores a semicolon-commented elaboration of Illya’s run.

findings.highlight: I guess it can’t be helped
findings.evidenceJa: なるようになるよな
findings.governingReading: whatever happens, happens
findings.explanation: Open acceptance of an uncertain outcome becomes resignation to an unavoidable one.

findings.highlight: I should treat her as a normal girl
findings.evidenceJa: 一人の少女として向き合わないと
findings.governingReading: I must face her as one individual girl
findings.explanation: Shirou’s commitment to meet Illya person-to-person becomes an assertion of normality and one-sided treatment.

findings.evidenceJa: それに寂しさを覚えながら
findings.governingReading: feeling loneliness at the sight
findings.explanation: Shirou’s emotional response to the empty playground is reassigned to the setting.

findings.evidenceJa: 理解不能のお嬢さん
findings.governingReading: this incomprehensible young lady
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock-polite internal designation is neutralized.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what you like, or anything
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの好き嫌いが判らない
findings.governingReading: I do not know Illya’s likes and dislikes
findings.explanation: Half of the explicit preference pair is omitted.

findings.highlight: Will you promise me you won’t get mad
findings.evidenceJa: なに訊いても怒らない？
findings.governingReading: will you refrain from getting angry no matter what I ask?
findings.explanation: Illya’s question is strengthened into an explicit requested promise.

findings.highlight: What the hell is she asking
findings.evidenceJa: 何を言い出すんだこのコは
findings.governingReading: what is this child suddenly saying?
findings.explanation: Unsupported profanity hardens Shirou’s flustered internal outburst.

findings.evidenceJa: 人をぶった斬っておいて
findings.governingReading: after cutting me down
findings.explanation: Illya’s near-bisection of Shirou is weakened to a generic attack.

findings.evidenceJa: 好き嫌いの話
findings.governingReading: talking about likes and dislikes
findings.explanation: The mutual, general topic is narrowed to Shirou liking Illya.

findings.evidenceJa: びくり、と肩を震わせて
findings.governingReading: Illya’s shoulders give a start
findings.explanation: The visible recoil is rendered in malformed English.

findings.highlight: I decided that I’d forget about us being Masters, but I guess I didn’t
findings.evidenceJa: マスター同士ってコトは忘れるって決めたのに、いきなりポカやっちまった
findings.governingReading: though I decided to set aside our being Masters, I immediately blundered by bringing it up
findings.explanation: Shirou’s specific conversational mistake and self-reproach become a vague failure to forget.

findings.highlight: you still want to talk big
findings.evidenceJa: 口だけは達者
findings.governingReading: you are remarkably glib for all that
findings.explanation: Illya’s jab that Shirou is capable only with his mouth is reduced to boastful speech.
